AttemptMetrics.title: AttemptMetrics

CandidateLineage.description:
How two candidates relate in the graph. Structural only: it says nothing about
whether their measurements can be compared (that is :class:`MetricPair`'s).
CandidateLineage.title: CandidateLineage

DimensionOut.description:
One limited dimension's balance.

Amounts are exact decimal strings, as the ledger keeps them.
DimensionOut.title: DimensionOut

MetricPair.description:
One metric on both candidates, and whether the two values can be compared.

``comparable`` is true only when both sides were measured under the same
evaluation fingerprint and, where a unit is recorded, the same unit. Only
then is ``difference`` given; otherwise it is ``None`` and ``reasons`` says
why. This is a recorded-identity check, not a statistical comparison:
harness comparisons (ADR-022 C1-C4) are H06's, not this API's.
MetricPair.title: MetricPair

MetricPointOut.description: One recorded point. ``optimizer_step`` is ``null`` when the event had none -- never 0.
MetricPointOut.title: MetricPointOut

MetricSeriesOut.description:
One series of one attempt: a name and unit, and the worker and rank that reported it.

One name reported in two units is two series: a value in ms is never
drawn on a line of seconds.

``count`` is every point recorded; ``points`` may be fewer when
``downsampled`` is true. Downsampling happens at read time and keeps
each bucket's lowest and highest value and the series' first and last
point, so a spike is never averaged away.
MetricSeriesOut.title: MetricSeriesOut

MetricSide.description: One candidate's measurement, with what it was measured under.
MetricSide.title: MetricSide

Problem.description: ``application/problem+json`` (§S8): fixed text, never a value read or sent.
Problem.title: Problem
